spiritgiven.comments: We’re glad we had good communication. Thank you for praising my good play. Thank you for praising our good play.
Thank you for always giving me positive words.
Thank you very much for your kind communication. We look forward to seeing you again.
Thank you for your wonderful fair-mindedness.
Thank you for actively trying to communicate with us from the early hours.
Thank you for the good game!
We respect your consistent attitude throughout the match.Thank you for your kindness. But we think it would be better if we could distinguish between kindness and rules.
Thank you for your kind communication. But we think we could play a better game if we were more calm judges of what happened.
We respect your fair-mindedness in accepting people's opinions.And we can play a better game if we are more clear with our calls and hand signals.Thank you!
We appreciate your fair-mindedness. You guys were always great with your gentlemanly attitude and fair judging.

We appreciate your fair-mindedness. We admire your willingness to accept the opinions of others. If there was one thing that could be improved, we thought that if we had a better understanding of the travel rules, we might be able to play a more enjoyable game.

Thank you for the great game! You guys were so fun and your smiles and communication were great. You guys are always updating the rules, which is great. There are two points I would like to make for improvement. First, we wanted to avoid contact during defense. Another thing I think is that uniform shirt and pants numbers should match. Let's meet again! Thank you.

spiritreceived.comments: Thank you for sorting out timekeeping and volunteer situation to run things smoothly! Also we are very appreciative of the clean non-contact play and your great energy!
Some physical contact that could be avoid, but in general great game.
We want to commend your positivity, celebration of all good plays, respectful communication and great rules knowledge. Thank you for role-modelling excellent hand signals and teaching us new rules.

Great competition! Resolution of calls were good even with language barriers. Contacted called and then violation due to not dropping count appropriately, rule was discussed with game advisor and resolved well!
Thank you for a great game! It was amazing playing against you!
Lots of contact and dangerous play
Very positive on the sidelines and on the field. They were receptive to conversation and talk the calls out. Players were very respectful of our team. It was a great game overall

Thank you for another great game! There were a few calls where the GA provided input, but your player did not take it into consideration. We encourage you to also consider their perspective moving forward.
Thank you again team Japan for another great game. We always know playing against you is going to be tough and we have to play our absolute best to win.
